The code behind this week

week-10-opentelemetry — what each file does, and how big it actually is
week-10-opentelemetry/
│
├── app/                          # the part that MAKES telemetry
│   ├── otel_setup.py        67   # tracer, sampler, OTLP exporter - the only
│   │                             # file that knows OpenTelemetry exists
│   ├── requirements.txt      7   # flask, gunicorn, the otel SDK + 2 instruments
│   ├── frontend/app.py      45   # calls the backend; does almost nothing else
│   ├── frontend/Dockerfile  19   # mcr.microsoft.com/azurelinux/base/python
│   ├── backend/app.py       48   # sleeps 250 ms on purpose, in a child span
│   └── backend/Dockerfile   19   # same base, same build, different service
│
├── terraform/
│   ├── versions.tf          48   # azurerm + azapi, HCP backend, 2nd provider
│   ├── variables.tf         53   # image tag, sampler ratio, backend work ms
│   ├── registry.tf          68   # ACR Basic, identity, AcrPull. No passwords
│   ├── observability.tf    115   # App Insights + the managed OTel agent
│   ├── apps.tf             173   # the two container apps, internal + external
│   └── outputs.tf           36   # the FQDN, the registry, the workspace
│
└── scripts/
    ├── deploy.sh           126   # registry FIRST, then az acr build, then the rest
    ├── validate.sh         232   # 6 checks. #5 proves ONE operation spans TWO
    │                             # services - the only test that means anything here
    └── cleanup.sh           93   # deletes the group, then verifies week 08 survived

# 10 resources, and the split is between making telemetry and routing it
#
# app/ is the only place that knows what a span is. The managed agent routes
# data; it does not create it. Microsoft's own FAQ: "Do I need to reference
# the OpenTelemetry SDK in my code? Yes." Enable the agent without an
# instrumented app and you get a working pipeline carrying nothing.
#
# observability.tf is where the week's uncomfortable line lives:
# local_authentication_enabled = true on Application Insights. Week 08 set
# that same argument to FALSE on the workspace, and that is what forced week
# 09's logging design. The agent authenticates with a connection string and
# Microsoft documents no ARM-authenticated alternative, so here it must be on.
#
# deploy.sh is three passes because a container app cannot reference an image
# tag that does not resolve yet: create the registry, build into it, then
# apply everything else.
